steps.title: Draw a reference line
steps.body: Use the Line tool to create a visible edge on the ground plane.

steps.title: Find endpoint snapping
steps.body: Move the cursor near an end of the segment and watch for endpoint feedback.

steps.title: Find midpoint snapping
steps.body: Move near the middle of the segment and identify midpoint feedback.

steps.title: Place a guide
steps.body: Use `G` for a grid guide or `T` for an axis guide at the current snap point.

actions.description: Guide command should be verified with `/scene/listCommands` for automation.

success.prompt: A guide is visible or the command is documented as unavailable in this build.
